units: <cite ref="Shabbat 63a:1">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> top <he>במ׳ רחב וכ׳</he> on a wide couch or on a narrow couch (an obscene disguise for a fat or a lean woman, v. <cite ref="C00490"><he>גּוּרְדְּלִי</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:1">Cant. R. to I, 12</cite> <he>במְסִבּוֹ ברקיע</he> ‘on his couch’ (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:12:1">ib.</cite>), in heaven.
